name: table
label: Table
description: Table name to get templates for

name: refreshRequested
label: Refresh requested
description: Use this property to refresh the templates component. The format will be a JSON object: refreshRequested {timestamp: Date.now()}

name: view
label: View
description: Form view to use when creating or editing a template

name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: Sys ID of the record to apply template to

name: encodedRecord
label: Encoded record
description: Encoded current Record to apply template to

name: fields
label: uppercase_fields
description: Map of fields {field_name: {...}, ...} that are shown in the form

name: hideSorting
label: Hide sort button
description: Hide the sort button so the user is not able to change the template sorting option

name: showPreviewIcon
label: Show template preview
description: Show or hide the template preview option on the card

name: showTemplateDescription
label: Show template description
description: Shows description of the template on the card

name: askConfirmationOnSameTemplate
label: Ask for confirmation when same template is applied on a record
description: Ask for confirmation when same template is applied on a record

name: hideFavorite
label: Hide favorite features
description: Hide the favorite features, including the favorite icon in the template card and the "Favorites" tab

name: nowDsDomainId
label: Domain Id
description: Id of the domain of the record

name: nowDsDomainScope
label: Domain Scope
description: Domain scope through which the record is being viewed

name: nowDsRecordId
label: Domain Record Id
description: Id of record in the domain

name: nowDsRecordTable
label: Domain Record Table
description: Table of the record in the domain
